Definition: a missile of attack, i.e. spear; also (figuratively) a shoot of growth; i.e. branch
KeyPassages: 2 Chronicles 23:10; Job 33:18; Nehemiah 4:17; Song of Solomon 4:13
BiblicalUsage: A weapon is what a man holds in his hand when the work is dangerous. The people stood every man with his weapon at the crowning of Joash, the builders on the wall held a weapon in one hand while they worked with the other, and God keeps back a man's soul from perishing by the sword. The Song uses the same word for the plants of the beloved's garden, an orchard of pomegranates.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the weapon in one hand and the work in the other is the picture of faithfulness under threat. They built and they guarded, and I hold that God's people still do both.
RelatedBooks: 2 Chronicles; Job; Nehemiah; Song of Solomon
